title: Thor: Love and Thunder
overview: Thor sets off on a journey unlike anything he has ever faced: a quest for inner peace. But his retirement is interrupted by Gorr the God Butcher, who seeks the extinction of the gods.

title: Jurassic World Dominion
overview: Four years after the destruction of Isla Nublar, dinosaurs now live and hunt alongside humans all over the world. The future of humanity hangs in the balance.

title: Minions: The Rise of Gru
overview: A young Gru dreams of becoming the world's greatest supervillain. With help from his Minions, he sets out to prove that even the smallest villain can make a big impression.

title: Top Gun: Maverick
overview: After more than thirty years of service, Pete Mitchell returns to train a new generation of pilots for a mission that demands the ultimate sacrifice.

title: The Black Phone
overview: A kidnapped teenager discovers that a disconnected phone can connect him to the voices of the previous victims who are determined to help him escape.

title: Lightyear
overview: The definitive origin story of Buzz Lightyear, the hero who inspired the toy, follows the legendary Space Ranger on an intergalactic adventure.

title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
overview: Doctor Strange travels into the multiverse to face a mysterious adversary and protect a teenager who can move between realities.

title: The Gray Man
overview: When a shadowy CIA agent uncovers agency secrets, a ruthless former colleague puts a bounty on his head and sends assassins around the world.

title: Elvis
overview: The life and music of Elvis Presley unfolds through the complicated relationship with his manager, Colonel Tom Parker.

title: Where the Crawdads Sing
overview: A woman who raised herself in the marshes of the deep South becomes a suspect when a man she once knew is found dead.
